comment: display.c mon_overrides_region(): a visible monster shows over a gas region when distu() <= r * (r + 1), where r is the hero's X-ray range when above 1. A Monk wearing the Eyes of the Overworld (X-ray range 3) steps away from a peaceful fog cloud; the cloud's harmless vapor (monmove.c m_everyturn_effect()) is redrawn while the fog cloud is two squares away, and newsym() must keep showing the fog cloud rather than the vapor.
